# platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner (Resource) (RC)

Runtime-independent native Agent registration. Core permanently retains its UUID and history. Destroy is refused and keeps Terraform state; decommission/erasure is unavailable. Clearing inventory disables new admission without cancelling accepted work. Registration does not activate or assign a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "agent_public_key" {
  type        = string
  description = "Public Ed25519 Agent authentication PEM. Keep its private key at the site."
}

variable "approved_inventory_file" {
  type        = string
  description = "Path to the public rollout-catalogue JSON export envelope, including declarations and inner native_execution."
}

locals {
  catalogue = jsondecode(file(var.approved_inventory_file))
}

resource "platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner" "example" {
  id          = "example-native-agent"
  description = "Native logical execution pool"
  runner_configuration = {
    key                 = var.agent_public_key
    max_parallel_jobs   = 4
    supported_protocols = local.catalogue.supported_protocols
    capabilities        = local.catalogue.capabilities
    native_execution    = jsonencode(local.catalogue.native_execution)
  }
  state_storage_configuration = {
    type             = "s3"
    s3_configuration = { bucket = "replace-with-state-bucket" }
  }
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

output "runner_registration_uuid" {
  value = platform-orchestrator_native_agent_runner.example.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Organization-local Runner ID using the Core pattern and the Native v2 runtime profile of 2–128 characters. Changing it requires replacement, whose protected destroy is refused.
- `runner_configuration` (Attributes) Public native registration only. No Job, DSN, private keys or local configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runner_configuration))
- `state_storage_configuration` (Attributes) The state storage configuration for the Runner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Public description. Use an explicit empty string to clear displayed text; Core cannot clear an existing description to null.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-issued immutable registration UUID, copied to private local configuration after Create.

<a id="nestedatt--runner_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runner_configuration`

Required:

- `capabilities` (Set of String) Explicit public capabilities exported from the approved site. An empty set is allowed.
- `key` (String) Agent authentication Ed25519 public PEM. The matching private key remains at the site.
- `max_parallel_jobs` (Number) Positive logical-pool admission capacity; no unlimited default.
- `supported_protocols` (Set of String) Explicit v2 pipeline and saved-plan protocols. Legacy v1 variants are forbidden.

Optional:

- `native_execution` (String) Inner approved public v2 catalogue JSON. Decode the rollout-catalogue export envelope with jsondecode(file(...)) or yamldecode(file(...)), use its supported_protocols/capabilities declarations and jsonencode(local.catalogue.native_execution). Required on new Create; null disables an existing registration. Never upload private local configuration.


<a id="nestedatt--state_storage_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `state_storage_configuration`

Required:

- `type` (String) The type of state storage configuration for the Runner.

Optional:

- `azurerm_configuration` (Attributes) The AzureRM state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--azurerm_configuration))
- `gcs_configuration` (Attributes) The GCS state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--gcs_configuration))
- `kubernetes_configuration` (Attributes) The Kubernetes state storage configuration for the Runner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--kubernetes_configuration))
- `s3_configuration` (Attributes) The S3 state storage configuration for the Runner (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_storage_configuration--s3_configuration))
